description: remaining-count renders the number of *completed* todos (todos.length - remainingCount) instead of the number of incomplete ones, i.e. the starter's inverted counter. Shows 剩余 2 项 initially; trips critical remaining-count-after-toggles (expects 4 then 3 then 2, sees 2 then 3 then 4) and non-critical toggle-twice-restores (expects 4 after the second click, sees 2). toggle-by-id-under-active-filter passes coincidentally because after one toggle completed and incomplete counts are both 3.
